title: HS Clubs mobile auth error, v1
description: The failure shape for every mobile auth step. The code set is closed so the app can decide between retry, restart and give up without reading prose; the description is for a human reading a log and never carries a code, verifier or token.

code.description: invalid_request: malformed or unknown parameter. unknown_school: schoolId is not this deployment. invalid_state: state did not match a pending flow. invalid_grant: code unknown, already used, or verifier mismatch. expired_code: code outlived its window. access_denied: the person cancelled. temporarily_unavailable: the identity provider or this deployment failed; retrying is reasonable.
